# 2. Data pre-processing 

Skip if the pre-processing has already been completed.

## 2.1 Peak alignment  
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
datafile <- c("hbnc_a_trim", "hbnc_b_trim", "hbnc_c_trim",
              "hbnn_a_trim", "hbnn_b_trim", "hbnn_c_trim",
              "hbnd_a_trim", "hbnd_b_trim", "hbnd_c_trim",
              "hboc_a_trim", "hboc_b_trim", "hboc_c_trim",
              "hbon_a_trim", "hbon_b_trim", "hbon_c_trim",
              "hbod_a_trim", "hbod_b_trim", "hbod_c_trim"
              )
datafiles <- file.path(dataset_path, datafile)

# Set up the mass tolerance for pre-processing 
ppm <- 30 

# Rotate the sections to make sure all the tissue sections have the same orientation
rotate = c(180, 0, 0,  
           180, 0, 0,
           180, 180, 180,
           180, 180, 0,
           180, 180, 0,
           180, 180, 180)

# Load the peak table and remove peaks that fall below the threshold.
deconv_peaklist <- read.csv(paste0(dataset_path, "/peak_list.csv"))
deconv_peaklist <- deconv_peaklist %>% filter(Intensity >= 5)

combined_imdata_path <- MSI_preprocessing(datafile = datafiles, 
                                          workdir = dataset_path,
                                          deconv_peaklist = deconv_peaklist,
                                          rotate = rotate,
                                          ppm = ppm)
```

## 2.2 Arbitrary Segmentation

This is an example of one run from "HBN control" group. 
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
imdata <- combinedimdata[, which(run(combinedimdata) == "hbnc_a_trim" )]
coordata <- retrieve_coord(imdata)

#Downsample the raw data from 75 µm to 150 µm resolution to improve computational efficiency
coordata$x_conv <-  ((coordata$x-min(coordata$x)) %/% 2) * 2 + min(coordata$x)
coordata$y_conv <-  ((coordata$y-min(coordata$y)) %/% 2) * 2 + min(coordata$y)

df <- unique(data.frame(x = coordata$x_conv,
                 y = coordata$y_conv,
                 run = coordata$run))

# Load segmentation definition
Virtual_segmentation_rankfile <- paste0(dataset_path, "radius_rank_bovin.csv")

# Apply arbitrary segmentation 
df <- virtual_segmentation(df, Virtual_segmentation_rankfile)
colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("x_conv" , "y_conv")
df$pattern <- factor(df$pattern, levels = c("OC", "IC", "Core"))

ggplot(df, aes(x_conv, -y_conv, fill = pattern)) +
            coord_equal()+ylab("y_conv")+
            geom_raster() + labs(fill = "Region") +
            scale_fill_manual(values = c("OC" = "#1b75be", 
                                        "IC" = "#89bff8", 
                                        "Core" = "#e3f1ff")) +
            theme_void()+
            theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
                  axis.title = element_blank(),
                  axis.text = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "right")
```

## 2.3 Spectrum calculation

Regional mean spectra from arbitrary segmentation were derived from raw data, with off-tissue areas removed prior to calculation.
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
#Using UMAP to remove the off-tissue areas
sp <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(spectra(imdata, "intensity")))
rownames(sp) <- mz(imdata)
sp_mt <- t(sp)
set.seed(2025)
umap.raw  <-uwot::umap(sp_mt,
                      n_neighbors = 40,
                      metric = "correlation",
                      spread = 1,
                      min_dist = 0.01,
                      n_threads = 47,
                      verbose = TRUE)


umap.res <- as.data.frame(umap.raw)
colnames(umap.res) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

set.seed(2025)
kmeans.res <- kmeans(umap.res[,c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")], centers = 5, nstart = 10)
umap.res$cluster <- as.factor(kmeans.res$cluster)

umap.res <- cbind(umap.res, coordata)

p1 <- ggplot(umap.res, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = cluster))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_article()+
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))

p2 <- ggplot(umap.res, aes(x,y, fill = cluster))+
  geom_raster()+
  theme_article()+ xlim(0, 160)+
  coord_equal()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.88, 0.2),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
    )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))

p3 <- ggplot(umap.res %>% filter(cluster %in% c(1,5)), aes(x,y, fill = cluster))+
  geom_raster(fill = "black")+
  theme_article()+ 
  coord_equal()+
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
    )

library(patchwork)
png(paste0(fig_path, "hbnc_a.png"), width = 4200, height = 1500, res = 400)
p1 + p2+ p3 + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1.05, 0.8))
dev.off()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
umap.res$label <- ifelse(umap.res$cluster %in% c(1, 5),
                         "off tissue",
                         "on tissue")



lt_cluster_mean <- list()

for (cluster in unique(umap.res$label)){
  sp_cluster <- sp[,umap.res$label == cluster]
  df_cluster_mean <- data.frame(mz = rownames(sp_cluster),
                                mean_spec = rowMeans(sp_cluster, na.rm = T),

  lt_cluster_mean[[as.character(cluster)]] <- df_cluster_mean
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
# The data will be transformed into a matrix format, with each row corresponding to an m/z value and each column representing a region or pixel. The matrix entries indicate the averaged intensity in that region or the convoluted pixel (150 µm). The "pixel_convolution()" function is used to calculate the regional mean spectra, during which tissue cracks are excluded to avoid bias in the regional averages. However, when computing spectra for convoluted pixels, the cracks are retained to ensure the convolution more accurately reflects the raw data. In this case, off-tissue areas must be removed to prevent background signals from affecting the results.

hbnc_a_region <- pixel_convolution(umap.res,
                                sp,
                                off_tissue_cluster = c(1,5),
                                convolution_level = "region")


hbnc_a_bin <- pixel_convolution(umap.res,
                                sp,
                                off_tissue_cluster = c(1,5),
                                convolution_level = "square_bin")
```

## 3.1 Layer 1 and 2: Bulk analysis and Arbitrary segmentation analysis

### 3.1.1 Bulk anslysis and segmentation analysis
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Imputation
region_df <- log10(mean_sp_df+1)

df_long <- region_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("mz") %>%
  pivot_longer(-mz, names_to = "sample", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(replicate = sub("@.*", "", sample)) 
df_avg <- df_long %>%
  group_by(mz, replicate) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = replicate, values_from = mean_intensity) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("mz")

hbnc_cols <- c("hbnc_a_trim", "hbnc_b_trim", "hbnc_c_trim")
hboc_cols <- c("hboc_a_trim", "hboc_b_trim", "hboc_c_trim")


df_avg_select <- df_avg %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(hbnc_cols, hboc_cols)))

df_avg_select$mz <- rownames(df_avg_select)
df_long <- df_avg_select %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(c(hbnc_cols, hboc_cols)),
               names_to = "replicate",
               values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(replicate, "hbnc") ~ "hbnc",
      str_detect(replicate, "hboc") ~ "hboc"
    )
  ) %>% filter(mz %in% mz_names)

df_long$name <- names(mz_names)[match(df_long$mz, mz_names)]
df_long$Region <- "Whole lens"
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_long_r <- region_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("mz") %>%
  pivot_longer(-mz, names_to = "sample", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  filter(mz %in% mz_names) %>% 
  separate(sample, into = c("id_part", "Region"), sep = "@", remove = FALSE) %>%
  separate(id_part, into = c("group", "replicate"), sep = "_", extra = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::select(mz, intensity, group, Region, replicate)%>% 
  filter(group %in% c("hbnc", "hboc") )


df_long_r$name <- names(mz_names)[match(df_long_r$mz, mz_names)]

df_long_all <- rbind(df_long, df_long_r)
df_long_all$Region <- factor(df_long_all$Region, levels = c("Whole lens", "OC", "IC", "Core"))
# 
png(paste0(fig_path, "whole_lens_comparison_seg.png"), width = 2700, height = 3300, res = 500)

p_bar <- ggplot(df_long_all %>% 
         filter(name %in%  c("GSH", "CySSG", "Cysteine")) %>%
         mutate(name = factor(name, 
                              levels = c("GSH", 
                                         "CySSG", 
                                         "Cysteine"))), 
       aes(x = group, y = intensity)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, 
               geom = "bar", 
               aes(fill = group), 
               alpha = 0.45, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, 
               fun.args = list(mult = 1),
```

### 3.1.2 Volcano plot by region 
```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Baseline comparison
my_comparisons <- list(c("hbnc","hboc"))
param <- SnowParam(workers = 2,  progressbar = F)
comparison_res <- bplapply(rownames(mean_sp_df), 
                           function(mz) {
  compare_groups_stats(mean_sp_df, mz, my_comparisons)
}, BPPARAM = param)

comparison_res_df <- do.call(rbind, comparison_res)
comparison_res_df$region <- factor(comparison_res_df$region, 
                                   levels = c("OC", "IC", "Core"))
comparison_res_df$Label <- names(mz_names)[match(comparison_res_df$m.z, mz_names)] 

filtered_df <- comparison_res_df %>%
  filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(-log10(p_value)))
filtered_df <- comparison_res_df %>%
  filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(-log10(p_value))) %>%
  mutate(Significance = ifelse(abs(log2FC) > 0.5 & p_value < 0.05, "Sig", "Non-sig"),
         change = case_when(
      log2FC > 0.5 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Increased",
      log2FC < -0.5 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Not Sig"
    ),
    size_plot = ifelse(change == "Not Sig", 0.5, -log10(p_value))
         )
```

```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
png(paste0(fig_path, "volcano_plot_hbnc_hboc.png"), width = 2500, height = 2000, res = 400)
p_vol <- ggplot() +

              alpha = 0.3, 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_jitter(data = filtered_df %>%
```

### 3.1.3 Heatmap by region
Prepare Heatmap data
```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
# Filter target molecules
region_filter <- region_df[which(as.numeric(rownames(region_df)) %in% mz_names),]
rownames(region_filter) <- names(mz_names)[match(as.numeric(rownames(region_filter)), mz_names)]
region_filter[region_filter <= 0] <- 0
region_filter_mt <- as.matrix(region_filter)

OC_cols   <- grep("@OC$", colnames(region_filter_mt), value = TRUE)
IC_cols   <- grep("@IC$", colnames(region_filter_mt), value = TRUE)
Core_cols <- grep("@Core$", colnames(region_filter_mt), value = TRUE)

log_OC   <- region_filter_mt[, OC_cols]
log_IC   <- region_filter_mt[, IC_cols]
log_Core <- region_filter_mt[, Core_cols]

log_OC <- log_OC %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                 select(matches("hbnc|hboc")) %>% as.matrix()
log_IC <- log_IC %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                 select(matches("hbnc|hboc")) %>% as.matrix()
log_Core <- log_Core %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                 select(matches("hbnc|hboc")) %>% as.matrix()
```

Heatmap Parameters
```{r}
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0,2.5, 5),  c("#2872d1", "white", "#ff0d0d"))
# col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2,0,2), c("#13a075", "white", "#e69f03"))
# col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2,0,2), c("#B3A9EB", "white", "#ffa500"))
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0,1,2,3,5), c("#69AADB", "#cae5f8", "#FAEFF5","#F2C5DA", "#D45590"))
# col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2,0,2), c("#0f86a9", "white", "#FC8452"))
```



```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
sample_OC <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(log_OC))
sample_IC <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(log_IC))
sample_Core <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(log_Core))

group_colors <- c("hbnc" = "#6A9BCB", "hboc" = "#CB5148")
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(min(c(log_OC, log_IC, log_Core), na.rm = TRUE), 
    median(c(log_OC, log_IC, log_Core), na.rm = TRUE), 
    max(c(log_OC, log_IC, log_Core), na.rm = TRUE)),
                      c("#440154", "#21908C", "#FDE725")
  ) 

col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_OC,
  col = list(Group = group_colors),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0, col = NA)  
)

```

Draw Heatmap
```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
ht_OC <- Heatmap(
    log_OC,
    name = "Relative Intensity",

)

        at = c(min(log_OC, na.rm = TRUE), max(log_OC, na.rm = TRUE)),

)
```

```{r}
my_upper <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)

  # Pearson correlation
  r <- cor(x, y, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(aes(0, 0, fill = r)) +
    geom_text(aes(0, 0, label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 9) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = "Pearson\ncorrelation",
      colours = c(
        "#0073a8", "#66b3e6", "#99d2e7", "white", "#ffb3b3", "#ff6666", "#cc3333"
      ),
      values = scales::rescale(c(-1, -0.5, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1)),
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_test()
}


my_lower <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    stat_density_2d(
      aes(fill = after_stat(level)),
      geom = "polygon",
      contour = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c(
        "#FFFFFF", "#17BECF", "#1F77B4", "#2CA02C",
        "#FFFF00", "#FF7F0E", "#D62728", "#8B0000"
      )
    ) +
    theme_test() +
     theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size  = 13,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size  = 13,
        color = "black"
      )
    )
}



my_diag_text <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  var_name <- as_label(mapping$x)

  ggplot() +
    geom_text(
      aes(0, 0, label = var_name),
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void()
}
```

### 3.2.6 FC map
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
HexBin_FC <- load_csv(paste0(dataset_path, "HexBin_FC_baseline_comparison.csv"))
hexbin_df_all <- load_csv(paste0(dataset_path, "hexbin_df_all.csv"))

info <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(colnames(hexbin_df_all), "@", 2))
colnames(info) <- c("run", "bin")
info$treatment <- sub("_.*", "", info$run)
```


```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
group1 = "hbnc"
group2 = "hboc"

pval_list <- list()

for (bin in unique(info$bin)){
  idx1 <- '&'(info$treatment == group1, info$bin == bin)
  idx2 <- '&'(info$treatment == group2, info$bin == bin)
  
  if (sum(idx1)> 1 && sum(idx2) > 1) {
    df1 <- hexbin_df_all[,idx1]
    df2 <- hexbin_df_all[,idx2]
    pvals <- apply(df1, 1, function(x, y) t.test(x, y)$p.value, y = df2)
  } else {
    pvals <- rep(NA, nrow(df1))
    names(pvals) <- rownames(df1)
  }
  
  pval_list[[as.character(bin)]] <- pvals
}

final_pvals <- as.data.frame(pval_list)
rownames(final_pvals) <- rownames(df1)
colnames(final_pvals) <- sub("^X", "", colnames(final_pvals))
```

### 3.3.1 Venn diagram of bulk analysis
```{r,  eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tt_hbnc_hboc <- run_ttest(region_df, "hbnc", "hboc")
tt_hbnc_hbon <- run_ttest(region_df, "hbnc", "hbon")
tt_hbnc_hbnn <- run_ttest(region_df, "hbnc", "hbnn")

sig_hboc_increase <- tt_hbnc_hboc$mz[tt_hbnc_hboc$pvalue < 0.05 & tt_hbnc_hboc$change == "Increased"]
sig_hbon_increase <- tt_hbnc_hbon$mz[tt_hbnc_hbon$pvalue < 0.05 & tt_hbnc_hbon$change == "Increased"]
sig_hbnn_increase <- tt_hbnc_hbnn$mz[tt_hbnc_hbnn$pvalue < 0.05 & tt_hbnc_hbnn$change == "Increased"]

venn_list_increase <- list(
  HBOc = sig_hboc_increase,
  HBOn = sig_hbon_increase,
  HBNn = sig_hbnn_increase
)

png(paste0(fig_path, "venn_increase.png"), width = 1000, height = 800, res =350)
plot(euler(venn_list_increase, shape = "circle"),
          list(fill = c( "#2b6a99","#ff7300","#1b7c3d"), alpha = 0.9),
          edges = list(col = NA),
          quantities = list(type = "counts", 
                            cex=0.9, 
                            col = c("white")), 
          legend = list(side = "right")
          )
dev.off()

sig_hboc_decrease <- tt_hbnc_hboc$mz[tt_hbnc_hboc$pvalue < 0.05 & tt_hbnc_hboc$change == "Decreased"]
sig_hbon_decrease <- tt_hbnc_hbon$mz[tt_hbnc_hbon$pvalue < 0.05 & tt_hbnc_hbon$change == "Decreased"]
sig_hbnn_decrease <- tt_hbnc_hbnn$mz[tt_hbnc_hbnn$pvalue < 0.05 & tt_hbnc_hbnn$change == "Decreased"]

venn_list_decrease <- list(
  HBOc = sig_hboc_decrease,
  HBOn = sig_hbon_decrease,

)
```

### 3.3.2 Bulk anslysis and segmentation amalysis
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
region_df <- log10(mean_sp_df+1)
df_long <- region_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("mz") %>%
  pivot_longer(-mz, names_to = "sample", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(replicate = sub("@.*", "", sample)) 
df_avg <- df_long %>%
  group_by(mz, replicate) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = replicate, values_from = mean_intensity) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("mz")

hbnc_cols <- c("hbnc_a_trim", "hbnc_b_trim", "hbnc_c_trim")
hbnn_cols <- c("hbnn_a_trim", "hbnn_b_trim", "hbnn_c_trim")
hboc_cols <- c("hboc_a_trim", "hboc_b_trim", "hboc_c_trim")
hbon_cols <- c("hbon_a_trim", "hbon_b_trim", "hbon_c_trim")

df_avg_select <- df_avg %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(hbnc_cols, hboc_cols, hbnn_cols, hbon_cols)))

df_avg_select$mz <- rownames(df_avg_select)
df_long <- df_avg_select %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(c(hbnc_cols, hboc_cols, hbnn_cols, hbon_cols)),
               names_to = "replicate",
               values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(replicate, "hbnc") ~ "hbnc",
      str_detect(replicate, "hboc") ~ "hboc",
      str_detect(replicate, "hbnn") ~ "hbnn",
      str_detect(replicate, "hbon") ~ "hbon"
    )
  ) %>% filter(mz %in% mz_names) %>% select(mz, replicate, intensity, group)

df_long$name <- names(mz_names)[match(df_long$mz, mz_names)]
df_long$Region <- "Whole lens"
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
comparison_res_df <- comparison_res_df %>% 
  mutate(comparison =  paste0(group2, "_vs_", group1))

df_wide <- comparison_res_df %>%
  select(m.z, region, comparison, log2FC, p_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = c(log2FC, p_value)
  )

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = abs(log2FC_hboc_vs_hbnc) > 0.5 & p_value_hboc_vs_hbnc < 0.05,
    sig2 = abs(log2FC_hbon_vs_hbnc) > 0.5 & p_value_hbon_vs_hbnc < 0.05,
    sig_status = case_when(
      sig1 & sig2 ~ "Both Significant",
      sig1 & !sig2 ~ "Only hbnc vs hboc",
      !sig1 & sig2 ~ "Only hbnc vs hbon",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_status = case_when(
      sig_status %in% c("Only hbnc vs hboc", "Only hbnc vs hbon") ~ 0.9,
      TRUE ~ 0.3
    )
  )

df_wide$region <- factor(df_wide$region, levels = c("OC", "IC", "Core"))
df_wide$sig_status <- factor(df_wide$sig_status, levels = c("Not Significant", "Both Significant", "Only hbnc vs hboc",
"Only hbnc vs hbon"))

label_df <- df_wide[df_wide$m.z %in% mz_names, ]
label_df$label <- names(mz_names)[match(label_df$m.z, mz_names)]

png(paste0(fig_path, "hbnc_hboc_hbon_fc_plot_3_rep.png") , width = 6000, height = 2500, res = 550)
ggplot(df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  filter(!if_any(everything(), ~ is.infinite(.))), 
       aes(x = log2FC_hboc_vs_hbnc, y = log2FC_hbon_vs_hbnc)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(region)) +
  theme_article()+
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank())+
  xlim(-10,10)+
  ylim(-10,10)+
  coord_equal()+
  labs(x = expression("HBOc vs HBNc (log"[2]*"[FC])"),
       y = expression("HBOn vs HBNc (log"[2]*"[FC])"))+
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_status), alpha = 0.7, size = 2)+
  geom_point(data = label_df %>% filter(!sig_status == "Not Significant"),
             aes(fill = sig_status),
             shape = 21, 
             color = "black",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 2.5,
             stroke = 0.6, 
             show.legend = FALSE)+
  
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
            "Not Significant" = "grey80",
            "Only hbnc vs hboc" = "#377bab", 
            "Only hbnc vs hbon" = "#7d3d92",

        )) +
  scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
            "Not Significant" = "grey80",
```

```{r}
library(circlize)

sectors <- colnames(region_matrices[[1]])
groups <- rownames(region_matrices[[1]])
group_colors <- c("hbnc" = "#6A9BCB", 
                  "hbnn" = "#014f97", 
                  "hboc" = "#CB5148", 
                  "hbon" = "#ff8787")


png(paste0(fig_path, "circular_plot.png"), width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 350)

circos.clear()
circos.initialize(sectors, xlim = c(0, length(groups)))

y_max <- 4.5
track_height <- 0.15

# Outermost track = Region 1
circos.track(ylim = c(0, y_max), track.height = track_height,
             panel.fun = function(x, y) {
               sector_index <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
               vals <- values1[, sector_index]
               positions <- seq_len(length(vals)) - 0.5
               circos.barplot(vals, positions, col = group_colors[rownames(values1)])
               
               # Add sector labels
               circos.text(sum(positions)/length(positions), y_max+2.5, sector_index,
                           facing = "bending.inside", cex = 0.8)
               
               # Label the track/layer on the left
               if(sector_index == sectors[1]) {
                 circos.text(x = -0.5, y = y_max/2, labels = "Whole lens", facing = "inside", cex = 0.8)
               }
             })

# Second track = Region 2
circos.track(ylim = c(0, y_max), track.height = track_height,
             panel.fun = function(x, y) {
               sector_index <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
               vals <- values2[, sector_index]
               positions <- seq_len(length(vals)) - 0.5
               circos.barplot(vals, positions, col = group_colors[rownames(values2)])
               
               if(sector_index == sectors[1]) {
                 circos.text(x = -0.5, y = y_max/2, labels = "OC", facing = "inside", cex = 0.8)
               }
             })

# Third track = Region 3
circos.track(ylim = c(0, y_max), track.height = track_height,
             panel.fun = function(x, y) {
               sector_index <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
               vals <- values3[, sector_index]
               positions <- seq_len(length(vals)) - 0.5
               circos.barplot(vals, positions, col = group_colors[rownames(values3)])
               
               if(sector_index == sectors[1]) {
                 circos.text(x = -0.5, y = y_max/2, labels = "IC", facing = "inside", cex = 0.8)
               }
             })

# Fourth track = Region 4
circos.track(ylim = c(0, y_max), track.height = track_height,
             panel.fun = function(x, y) {
               sector_index <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
               vals <- values4[, sector_index]
               positions <- seq_len(length(vals)) - 0.5

               if(sector_index == sectors[1]) {
                 circos.text(x = -0.5, y = y_max/2, labels = "Core", facing = "inside", cex = 0.8)

             })
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}
  for (cl in clusters) {
    
    bins_in_cluster <- hexbin_sampled$bin[hexbin_sampled$cluster == cl]
    
    b <- bins_in_cluster[1]
    
    p <- Plot_FC_HeatMap(
      hexbin_average_df = hexbin_average_df,
      comparisons        = comparisons,
      mz                 = mz,
      HexBin_index       = b
    ) +
      labs(title = paste0("m/z = ", mz, " | Cluster ", cl)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 8,
                                      hjust = 0.5))
    
    plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p
  }
}

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm")
  )

png(paste0(fig_path, "FC_combined_plot.png"), width = 2300, height = 2200, res = 350)
combined_plot
dev.off()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=F}
hbo_mean_raw <- hexbin_average_flt %>% select(matches("^hboc"))

  idx1 <- which(hbo_mean_info$bin == bin_idx)
  idx2 <- which(hbn_mean_info$bin == bin_idx)
  
  
  # If both idx1 and idx2 exist, calculate fc_bin
  if (length(idx1) > 0 && length(idx2) > 0) {
    
    fc_bin_raw[, paste0(bin_idx)] <- hbo_mean_raw[, idx1] / hbn_mean_raw[, idx2]
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=F}
hbn_mean_raw <- hexbin_average_flt %>% select(matches(paste0("^", comparisons[[comparison]][1])))
hbo_mean_raw <- hexbin_average_flt %>% select(matches(paste0("^", comparisons[[comparison]][2])))

hbn_mean_info <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(colnames(hbn_mean_raw), "@", 2))
colnames(hbn_mean_info) <- c("run", "bin")
hbo_mean_info <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(colnames(hbo_mean_raw), "@", 2))
colnames(hbo_mean_info) <- c("run", "bin")

fc_bin_raw <- data.frame(mz = rownames(hbn_mean_raw))

for (bin_idx in unique(hbo_mean_info$bin)) {
  idx1 <- which(hbo_mean_info$bin == bin_idx)
  idx2 <- which(hbn_mean_info$bin == bin_idx)
  
  # If both idx1 and idx2 exist, calculate fc_bin
  if (length(idx1) > 0 && length(idx2) > 0) {
    
    fc_bin_raw[, paste0(bin_idx)] <- hbo_mean_raw[, idx1] / hbn_mean_raw[, idx2]
  }
}

rownames(fc_bin_clean) <- rownames(fc_bin_raw)

  left_join(fc_GSH %>% select(bin, FC, comparison),
    by = c( "bin"))

}
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hexbin_df_all <- load_csv(paste0(dataset_path, "hexbin_df_all.csv"))
hexbin_info <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(colnames(hexbin_df_all), "@", 2))
colnames(hexbin_info) <- c("run", "bin")
hexbin_info <- hexbin_info %>% 
  mutate(treatment = sub("_.*", "", run),
    replicate = sub("^[^_]+_([a-z])_.*", "\\1", run))

hexbin_df_hbn <- hexbin_df_all[, which(hexbin_info$treatment == "hbnc")]
hexbin_info_hbn <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(colnames(hexbin_df_hbn), "@", 2))
colnames(hexbin_info_hbn) <- c("run", "bin")
hexbin_info_hbn <- hexbin_info_hbn %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(sub("_.*", "", run)),
    replicate = sub("^[^_]+_([a-z])_.*", "\\1", run))

umap_res_hbn <- umap_baseline %>% 
  filter(treatment == "hbnc",
         cluster %in% c(3,4,5))

hexbin_info_hbn <- hexbin_info_hbn %>% 
  left_join(umap_res_hbn[, c("treatment", "bin", "cluster")], 
            by = c("treatment", "bin") ) 

na_idx <- which(is.na(hexbin_info_hbn$cluster))
hexbin_info_hbn <- hexbin_info_hbn[-na_idx,] 
hexbin_mt_hbn <- t(hexbin_df_hbn[,-na_idx])
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
oplsda_res <- opls(hexbin_mt_hbn, factor(hexbin_info_hbn$cluster))
saveRDS(oplsda_res, paste0(dataset_path, "plsda_res.RDS"))

score <- as.data.frame(oplsda_res@scoreMN)
score$cluster <- factor(hexbin_info_hbn$cluster)
vip <- data.frame(vip = oplsda_res@vipVn,
                  mz = colnames(hexbin_mt_hbn))

threshold <- quantile(vip$vip, 0.95)
vip_top <- vip %>%
  arrange(desc(vip)) %>% 
  filter(vip>threshold)

vip_top$mz_round <- round(as.numeric(vip_top$mz), 4)

png(paste0(fig_path, "vip_plot.png"), width = 1800, height = 4000, res =400)
ggplot(vip_top, aes(x = reorder(as.factor(mz_round), vip), y = vip)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = as.factor(mz_round), y = 0, yend = vip), color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#0073C2FF") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_article() +
  labs(x = "m/z", y = "VIP score", 
       title = "Top 5% m/z based on VIP scores") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
dev.off()

loading <- as.data.frame(oplsda_res@loadingMN) 
loading$abs_val <- abs(loading[,1])

top_cutoff <- quantile(loading$abs_val, 0.95)
top_loading <- loading %>% filter(abs_val >= top_cutoff)
top_loading$variable <- rownames(top_loading)
top_loading$variable <- fct_reorder(top_loading$variable, top_loading[,1])
```

## Alignment comparison 

### Previous Method
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
pixel_info <- read.csv(paste0(dataset_path, "pixel_info.csv"))

pixeldf <- pixel_info 

for (imsrun in unique(pixeldf$run)){
  pixeldf$x[pixeldf$run == imsrun]->x
  pixeldf$y[pixeldf$run == imsrun]->y
  x_scale<-(x-(max(x)-min(x))/2)/(max(y)-min(y))
  y_scale<-(y-(max(y)-min(y))/2)/(max(y)-min(y))
  pixeldf$x_scale[pixeldf$run == imsrun]<-x_scale 
  pixeldf$y_scale[pixeldf$run == imsrun]<-y_scale
}


bin <- hexbin(pixeldf$x_scale,pixeldf$y_scale, xbins=round(sqrt(nrow(pixeldf)/6/length(unique(pixeldf$run)))), IDs= TRUE)

pixeldf$bin <- bin@cID
write.csv(pixeldf,paste0(wd,"pixeldf_old.csv"), row.names = F)


ggplot(pixeldf, 
       aes(x_scale, y_scale))+
  geom_point()+
  coord_equal()+
  theme_article()+
  facet_wrap(vars(run))
```

```{r}
runs <- c("hbnc_a_trim",
          "hbnc_b_trim",
          "hbnc_c_trim")

hexbin_list <- list(
  all = hexbin_df_all,
  old = hexbin_df_old,
  raw = hexbin_df_raw
)

results <- data.frame(
  dataset = character(),
  run1    = character(),
  run2    = character(),
  cor     = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (dname in names(hexbin_list)) {

  hexbin_df <- hexbin_list[[dname]]

  for (i in 1:(length(runs) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):length(runs)) {

      cor_val <- HexBin_cor(
        hexbin_df_all = hexbin_df,
        mz_value = 306.0773,
        run1 = runs[i],
        run2 = runs[j]
      )

      results <- rbind(
        results,
        data.frame(
          dataset = dname,
          run1    = runs[i],
          run2    = runs[j],
          cor     = cor_val
        )
      )
    }
  }
}

results
```


```{r}
results$comparison <- paste(results$run1, results$run2, sep = " vs ")

results$dataset <- dplyr::recode(
  results$dataset,
  all = "Baycentric Deformation",
  old = "Rigid Transformation",
  raw = "No Transformation"
)

results$dataset <- factor(
  results$dataset,
  levels = c(
    "No Transformation",
    "Rigid Transformation",
    "Baycentric Deformation"
  )
)



ggplot(results, aes(x = dataset, y = cor, color = comparison, group = comparison)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "Pearson Correlation"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(

      "hbnc_a_trim vs hbnc_c_trim" = "#D95F02",
      "hbnc_b_trim vs hbnc_c_trim" = "#7570B3"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "hbnc_a_trim vs hbnc_b_trim" = "Rep 1 vs Rep 2",
      "hbnc_a_trim vs hbnc_c_trim" = "Rep 1 vs Rep 3",
      "hbnc_b_trim vs hbnc_c_trim" = "Rep 2 vs Rep 3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_article() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.84, 0.1),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = alpha("white", 0.7),
      colour = NA
    )
  )
```

```{r}
run_sets <- list(
  hbnc = c("hbnc_a_trim", "hbnc_b_trim", "hbnc_c_trim"),
  hbnn = c("hbnn_a_trim", "hbnn_b_trim", "hbnn_c_trim"),
  hboc = c("hboc_a_trim", "hboc_b_trim", "hboc_c_trim"),
  hbon = c("hbon_a_trim", "hbon_b_trim", "hbon_c_trim")
)

hexbin_list <- list(
  all = hexbin_df_all,
  old = hexbin_df_old,
  raw = hexbin_df_raw
)


results <- data.frame(
  dataset = character(),
  run_set = character(),
  mz      = character(),
  run1    = character(),
  run2    = character(),
  cor     = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


for (dname in names(hexbin_list)) {
  hexbin_df <- hexbin_list[[dname]]

  for (set_name in names(run_sets)) {
    runs <- run_sets[[set_name]]

     for (mz_val in mz_names) {

           for (i in 1:(length(runs) - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):length(runs)) {

          cor_val <- HexBin_cor(
            hexbin_df_all = hexbin_df,
            mz_value = as.numeric(mz_val),  
            run1 = runs[i],
            run2 = runs[j],
            runs = runs
          )

          results <- rbind(
            results,
            data.frame(
              dataset = dname,
              run_set = set_name,
              mz      = mz_val,
              run1    = runs[i],
              run2    = runs[j],
              cor     = cor_val
            )
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

results

```
